name: Orion Atlas Capture
description: Atlas-capture scene for the Orion (heavy mercenary gunship). Mesh switched 2026-05-26 to the real Privateer Orion (MRCHSHIP.3ds from the wcnews fan archive), replacing an earlier DD_TUG stand-in. The new mesh has ~57k tris and 17 material zones with M1-prefixed Origin textures (M1ENG/M1SID/M1TOP/M1WNG) — the actual Privateer Orion textures, not WCU placeholders. ambient_floor 0.45 + spec 0.5 = same defaults as Galaxy/Centurion atlas scenes. clay_mode false because we want the textured render for the AI to copy. Capture via tools/render_ship_atlas.py --ship orion.
